I searched for the service credit percentage set by Amendment No. 1 to the Master Services Agreement. The relevant file, `contracts/amendment-1-2021.pdf`, exists in the documents folder but is **encrypted** — the indexing tool (ow_query) reported it was "refused as encrypted, so no document was written," and it requires a password to open (which I do not have and have no means to obtain via the available tools). I also checked `msa-2019.pdf` (the base MSA) via ow_query, but it only returned section headers (Definitions, Service Levels, Agreement escalation services) with no service-credit percentage content — the amendment itself is the document most likely to contain the answer, and it cannot be read.
